name: Kasugai Noa
source: A classmate of Toma's. She doesn't like Toma nor does she particularly like the idea of a sex card but she still understands the importance of what he's trying to accomplish. So she's the first to have sex with him in front of everyone on the classroom floor to teach the importance of sex anytime, anywhere. Besides, sex in public allows others to see her beautiful body while she's having sex.
